It may not be as fine as people want (ie. you don't necessarily get an exact say on how it is spent), but you DO have a chance to speak your mind to get things done as you wish. You get to vote for congressmen and other government figures who then make the laws to spend the money as benefits society as a whole. That's why tax dollars go for things people take for granted, like roads and water pipes and electrical lines and fire departments.

If you don't like the way the laws are being made, you have the right as a taxpayer to vote out your political representatives and put someone in their place. You have the right to contact your politicians and demand change. You have the right to speak your mind in public about how things should work.
